name: Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana- SEBC & EBC
benefit: **Monetary Assistance:** - ₹12,000 is provided for the marriage of a daughter. > **NOTE:** If the marriage occurred before April 1, 2021, assistance of ₹10,000 is provided.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a woman belonging to a Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC) or Economically Backward Class (EBC). 1. The annual family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-. 1. The marriage must be legally registered. 1. The assistance is limited to two daughters per family.
